header.comment: This configuration file was automatically created by GParserBuilder

init_n_parents.comment: The initial number of parents in a population

n_parents_lb.comment: The lower boundary for variations of the number of parents

n_parents_ub.comment: The upper boundary for variations of the number of parents

init_n_children.comment: The initial number of children in a population

n_children_lb.comment: The lower boundary for the variation of the number of children

n_children_ub.comment: The upper boundary for the variation of the number of children

init_amalgamation_lklh.comment: The initial likelihood for an individual being created from cross-over rather than just duplication

amalgamation_lklh_lb.comment: The lower boundary for the variation of the amalgamation likelihood

amalgamation_lklh_ub.comment: The upper boundary for the variation of the amalgamation likelihood

init_min_ad_prob.comment: The initial lower boundary for the variation of ad_prob

init_ad_prob_range.comment: The initial range for the variation of ad_prob

init_ad_prob_start_percentage.comment: The start value for ad_prob relative to the allowed value range

init_adapt_ad_prob.comment: The initial value of the strength of adProb_ adaption

adapt_ad_prob_lb.comment: The lower boundary for the variation of the strength of adProb_ adaption

adapt_ad_prob_ub.comment: The upper boundary for the variation of the strength of adProb_ adaption

init_min_sigma.comment: The initial minimum sigma for gauss-adaption in ES

min_sigma_lb.comment: The lower boundary for the variation of the lower boundary of sigma

min_sigma_ub.comment: The upper boundary for the variation of the lower boundary of sigma

init_sigma_range.comment: The initial maximum range for sigma

sigma_range_lb.comment: The lower boundary for the variation of the maximum range of sigma

sigma_range_ub.comment: The upper boundary for the variation of the maximum range of sigma

init_sigma_range_percentage.comment: The initial percentage of the sigma range as a start value

init_sigma_sigma.comment: The initial strength of self-adaption of gauss-mutation in ES

sigma_sigma_lb.comment: The lower boundary for the variation of the strength of sigma adaption

sigma_sigma_ub.comment: The upper boundary for the variation of the strength of sigma adaption

eval_policy.comment: Specifies which strategy should be used to calculate the evaluation:
0 (a.k.a. USESIMPLEEVALUATION): Always call the evaluation function, even for invalid solutions
1 (a.k.a. USEWORSTCASEFORINVALID) : Assign the worst possible value to our fitness and evaluate only valid solutions
2 (a.k.a. USESIGMOID): Assign a multiple of validity_level_ and sigmoid barrier to invalid solutions, apply a sigmoid function to valid evaluations

steepness.comment: When using a sigmoid function to transform the individual's fitness,
this parameter influences the steepness of the function at the center of the sigmoid.
The parameter must have a value > 0.

barrier.comment: When using a sigmoid function to transform the individual's fitness,
this parameter sets the upper/lower boundary of the sigmoid.
The parameter must have a value > 0.

maxmode.comment: Specifies whether the individual should be maximized (1) or minimized (0)
Note that minimization is the by far most common option.

n_runs_per_optimization.comment: Specifies the number of optimizations performed

fitness_target.comment: The fitness below which optimization should stop

iteration_threshold.comment: The maximum number of iterations per sub-optimization

meta_optimization_target.comment: The target for the meta-optimization: best fitness (0),
minimum number of solver calls (1), multi-criterion with best fitness
and smallest number of solver calls as target (2)

sub_ea_config.comment: Path and name of the configuration file used for the (sub-)evolutionary algorithm
